rust.name: crates/factorium/src/heavy.rs:196:9: replace App::beside_ended with ()
rust.why: Only the idle scenario's three-tick loop relies on this wait; if the steps finish fast, three ticks may still find them ended, so the wait would never be tested.

rust.name: crates/host/src/clock.rs:102:9: replace <impl Drop for Gone>::drop with ()
rust.why: asleep() skips waits that have passed, and until() looks again every LOOK anyway, so losing both the removal and the notify may only slow scenarios down instead of failing them.

rust.name: crates/host/src/clock.rs:82:63: replace += with *= in <impl Clock for ManualClock>::sleep
rust.why: An entry that starts at 0 stays 0, so every wait counts as zero; this only fails if a scenario actually checks that asleep() is nonzero, instead of hanging until STUCK.
